comments.text: object type 15, the game's last boss, the Machine: a face of metal five sprites across and five rows down (shapes $99 to $B1), drawn by sprites 3 to 7 used again for each row by interrupts of its own. Its left and right edges, rows 1 to 3, are two guns that rain shots down diagonally; only when both are wrecked can shots hurt the face itself. It falls in from above, then wanders up and down and left and right at random, and touching it hurts. Beaten, it bursts for 10,000 points and the game's ending starts

its first frame waits, the object left new, until the view is at row 27 or 28 and column 274 (only the low byte $12 is tested; within reach of the boss's record no other column has it), the hero is on the ground ($29 and $26 zero) and the fine scroll is at rest ($17 = 4, $16 = 3)
not yet: the object stays new

opens the wall left of the arena: the map's solid pillar blocks at block column 65, rows 9 and 10 ($91C5, $9229), become block $8E, the same pillar the hero can pass, so the way back to the ship is open after the fight. Then characters $CD and $CE take the shapes of the guns' shots ($8A15)
its first ways: across none ($BCFF = 0) and down ($BD00 = 1) at 4 lines a frame, both for 211 frames; 1,103 energy for the face ($BD04, $BD05 = $044F) and 300 for each gun ($BD0B, $BD10 = $012C)
